rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a microorganism, especially in scientific or explanatory contexts.

example.english: You can only see the microorganism under a microscope.
example.traditional: 微生物喺顯微鏡下面先至睇得見。
example.jyutping: mei4 sang1 mat6 hai2 hin2 mei4 geng3 haa6 min6 sin1 zi3 tai2 dak1 gin3

rows.note: Use this colloquial term when talking generally about microbes or germs rather than identifying the organism scientifically.

example.english: These raw oysters may contain a microorganism.
example.traditional: 呢啲生蠔未煮熟，入面可能有菌。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 saang1 hou4 mei6 zyu2 suk6 jap6 min6 ho2 nang4 jau5 kwan2
